arithmetic: All local eliminations use integer equality components and nonzero integer multiples of single monomials; division over Q gives the unit RREF. No finite-field rank is used in the theorem.
claim_boundary: This is an ordinary characteristic-zero theorem for the rank-at-most-75 product-shadow locus at dimension 47. It does not treat the dimension-46 locus, does not by itself prove ChowRank(perm_6)>=29, and makes no border-rank claim.
